name: Decision Synthesis Nightly
description: Run the decision_logger synthesis script nightly to scan the decisions table for contradictions, stance drift, and entity promotion patterns. Results saved to ~/.hermes/cron/output/decision_synthesis_<date>.json
prompt:
Run the decision synthesis job:

DECISION_SYNTH_OUTPUT=/home/home_user/.hermes/cron/output /home/home_user/.hermes/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python3 /home/home_user/decision_logger/synthesis.py

This scans the decisions table in brain-postgres (localhost:5433) and produces a synthesis report about contradictions, stance drift, and entity changes. Results written to ~/.hermes/cron/output/decisions-synth-*.md

Respond with [SILENT] on success. If there are errors, report them.
